messages:
Juan (sales): FYI incoming request from GreenBank — they want Koala-7b-instruct pinned in eu-west-1 and us-east-1, must be pinned to v1.2 for compliance. Also require KMS FIPS-140 keys and audit logs. Contracted go-live target: ~6 weeks. Latency goal: <=150ms p95 for 512 tokens. Asking if we can do hosted + VPC peering or need Dedicated.

Amy (product): Thanks Juan. Can you confirm: 1) Is Dedicated required by contract or is hosted with VPC/KMS acceptable? 2) Any throughput/queries-per-second commitments? 3) Are they expecting us to run evals or provide our internal perf numbers?

Juan (sales): Contract language prefers Dedicated but allows hosted with private networking + KMS if we provide SOC-like audit logs. Committed QPS is 40 sustained with 200 peak bursts. They insisted on version pin (v1.2) and rollback protection. They're flexible on canary but want deterministic SLOs for SLAs.

Sienna (support): I've opened ticket #7890 for the customer intake. They attached sample prompts and a small test corpus — results show token mix ~70% short instructions, 30% ~400–800 token replies. Also called out PII redaction requirements in EU region.

Arjun (ml): Quick notes on Koala-7b-instruct: upstream weights are available but we haven't validated the v1.2 build on our quant paths. 8-bit quant (q8) looks promising but we need quality regression checks vs fp16. For 512 tokens, expected p95 on a single A10G-like instance (our hosted path) ~180ms fp16; with int8 kernels could drop to ~120–140ms but needs validation. Also note the tokenizer differences — need to lock tokenization manifest to avoid drift.

Mika (eng): Capacity note — eu-west Dedicated pool is fairly booked next 4–6 weeks; we can provision burst capacity but it's not free. If we do hosted + VPC, we can route them to us-east for initial canary while we provision EU Dedicated. Also need to confirm model size after quantization and whether it fits our current serving nodes.

intake-bot: Automatic intake created: model=koala-7b-instruct, requested_versions=[v1.2], regions=[eu-west-1,us-east-1], compliance=KMS-FIPS, sla_target=6_weeks, qps_target=40. TicketID=INTAKE-4712.

Amy (product): Proposed acceptance criteria for triage (please comment):
- Security: KMS-FIPS + audit export path validated in eu-west-1 (evidence accepted).
- Performance: p95 <=150ms for 512 tokens on the target deployment (hosted or Dedicated), measured on our benchmarking harness.
- Quality: no >2% delta in toxicity/accuracy on their eval set vs our baseline when using the production quant profile.
- Rollout: staged canary (us-east -> eu-west), automated rollback, pinned to v1.2 with manifest hash in config.
- Cost/contract: sales to confirm Dedicated commit or acceptance of hosted pricing with burst fees.

Sienna (support): +1 on acceptance criteria. Add: data residency proof for EU (logs/export must remain in eu-west unless customer signs cross-border addendum).

Arjun (ml): I'll run a quick bench matrix (fp16, q8, q4) and post numbers by EOW. If q8 meets quality, recommend that as default to hit latency. Also need model card/license check — no restrictive clauses.

Mika (eng): If we treat this as P1 (contracted), we should create an infra TODO: reserve 2x Dedicated instances in eu-west for final verification, and a canary route in us-east. Also require a model manifest with:
```
model: koala-7b-instruct
version: v1.2
hash: <commit-or-checksum>
regions: [eu-west-1, us-east-1]
quant_profiles: [fp16, q8]
```

Juan (sales): Confirming priority = P1. Customer will sign addendum if needed. They want weekly syncs.

Amy (product): Action items summary (I'll own):
- Product: create backlog ticket PROD-1347 (Model onboard: koala-7b-instruct v1.2, pin+region, P1).
- ML: perf & quality matrix by EOW (Arjun).
- Eng: capacity reservation plan + cost delta for Dedicated vs hosted (Mika).
- Support: escalate ticket #7890 and validate EU data residency constraints (Sienna).
- Sales: confirm final commitment and signoff on Dedicated or hosted pricing (Juan).

Mika (eng): Noted. Please attach model weights link + license and the checksum into the ticket. Without the manifest we can't proceed with provisioning.

Arjun (ml): Adding preliminary perf numbers to the intake ticket: fp16 ~180ms p95 (512 tokens), q8 estimate 125ms p95. I'll add test harness logs.

Amy (product): OK — triaged as P1 and moving to backlog. Please add any follow-ups in PROD-1347. Scheduling weekly check-ins starting Monday. :spiral_calendar: :thumbsup:

Juan (sales): Thanks — I'll ping GreenBank and ask for the manifest + legal signoff.

Sienna (support): Ticket #7890 updated with EU residency checklist.

intake-bot: Backlog item created: PROD-1347. Assigned: Amy (product).
